scripts.build:vercel: cd journal_learning_app && if [ ! -d "$HOME/flutter" ]; then curl -L https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/linux/flutter_linux_3.32.5-stable.tar.xz -o flutter.tar.xz && tar xf flutter.tar.xz -C $HOME && rm flutter.tar.xz; fi && export PATH=$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH && flutter config --no-analytics && flutter pub get && flutter build web --release --dart-define=SUPABASE_URL=$SUPABASE_URL --dart-define=SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY --dart-define=GEMINI_API_KEY=$GEMINI_API_KEY
